title: Compare published LLM benchmark results
prompt: Compare Claude Opus 4.6, OpenAI GPT-4.5, and Google Gemini 2.5 Pro using published evidence for MMLU-family benchmarks, SWE-bench, and multilingual capability. Prefer official model/system cards and benchmark papers. For every score, name the exact benchmark variant, model, evaluation setup, source URL, and publication date. Do not treat MMLU, MMMLU, and Global MMLU Lite as interchangeable; distinguish single-attempt from multi-attempt results. If comparable evidence is unavailable, mark the cell missing rather than infer it. Produce a report with a comparison table and explain which values cannot be fairly ranked.
requested_dimensions: MMLU-family result for each requested model, with exact variant
SWE-bench result for each requested model, with exact variant and attempt setup
Multilingual evidence for each model, or an explicit evidence gap
Source provenance and date for every reported score
acceptance_criteria: Every numeric score is traceable to a source that supports that exact model and metric
Benchmark variants and evaluation setups are not silently mixed
Missing or conflicting evidence is explicitly marked
Final report conclusions follow from the cited evidence
